stemBlocks: An experiment was carried out to separate the four amino acids present in a mixture of amino acids. A spot of this mixture was placed on chromatography paper. The bottom of the paper was placed in solvent 1 and left until the solvent nearly reached the top of the paper. The paper was then thoroughly dried and turned by 90°. The procedure was then repeated with solvent 2. The amino acids were then identified with reference to known $R_f$ values in the respective solvents.
